rows.response_text: To bake the best potato, heat the oven to 350°F and position racks in the top and bottom thirds. Wash the potato thoroughly and dry it. Sprinkle with kosher salt and place the potato directly on the oven rack in the middle of the oven. Place a baking sheet on the lower rack to catch any drippings. Bake for 1 hour or until the skin feels crisp but the flesh beneath feels soft.
